notes.title: Condition Red 1.1.01
notes.notes:
Release 1.1.01
[*] Sniper rifle remembers last zoom level
[*] Humanoid AI activation range tweaks in levels 03, 04 and 06.

Release 1.1
Adds:
[*] Levels 4,5 and 6.
[*] Creature AIs no longer take damage when off-screen.

Bugs fixed:
[*] Humanoid AI activation and deactivation on player approach tweaked.
[*] Traps meant for player can now damage most AIs.
[*] Humanoid AI weapon switching animations in place for AIs with multiple weapons.
[*] Weapon and Ammo pickup sounds now unique for every weapon.
[*] Manual reload failing on infinite ammo pistol after 4-5 levels.
[*] Roll disabled after encountering floating blocks.

notes.title: Condition Red 1.07.3
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Crosshairs are once again hidden during reloading.
[*]Meshes replaced and some materials and textures have been updated. HUD tweaks.
[*]Splash sound when entering and exiting water functional again.
[*]Fast turn in depth (2.5D) shooting mode will allow toggle camera position from left to right and v.v.
[*]Fast turn and forwards/backwards roll keys on gamepad swapped.
[*]Reduced memory footprint for levels 01 . There should no longer be texture blurring for background objects with a 2GB video card in level 01.
[*]Minor tweaks to geometry in level 01. These changes should be unnoticeable during play.
[/list]

notes.title: Condition Red 1.07.2
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Alters some models and materials.
[*] New HUD
[/list]

notes.title: Condition Red 1.07.1
notes.notes:
Condition Red 1.07.1
- Corrects issue with creature AI orientation near corpses.


Condition Red 1.07
Playability enhancements including 
[list]
[*]Switching weapons while reloading (reload cancel)
[*]Fast turn 180.
[*]Sprint right from the get go including the ability to sprint, jump and continue sprinting.
[/list]
        
Level enhancements including
[list]
[*] Exterior visibility through portholes
[*]Corpse litter.
[/list]

notes.title: Condition Red 1.06
notes.notes: - Cosmetic improvements (weapon models, destructible meshes) and playability enhancements.

notes.title: Condition Red 1.05
notes.notes:
- Aiming system changed to free aiming.
- Gamepad defaults to free aiming but can be reverted to classic aiming from controls menu. Free aiming slider replaces normal aiming slider in free aiming mode.
- Mouse sensitivity changes.

notes.title: Condition Red 1.04
notes.notes:
[b][u]1.04[/u][/b]

- Final set of bug fixes before level 04.
- minor improvements.

notes.title: Condition Red 1.02
notes.notes:
[u][b]1.02[/b][/u]

- Optimises lighting in level 02. Level 02 performance improved significantly.
- Fixes bugs with blocks.
- Player character animation changes.

[u][b]1.01[/b][/u]

- General performance improvement across all levels.
- Flanking enemy cam exit bug fixes.

notes.title: Condition Red Initial Early Access Release
notes.notes:
We are happy to release the first Early Access version of Condition Red!

The initial release of the game contains the first 3 levels.

We are still working on the remaining 7 levels of the game in addition to improving the AI and other gameplay elements.
